name: SIFT 关键点取证
description: 使用 Scale-Invariant Feature Transform keypoints 以检测 duplicated and manipulated image regions.
algorithm: SIFT-Based Copy-Move Forgery Detection with Geometric Verification
mechanism: 提取 SIFT keypoints and descriptors from the image, then matches them to find duplicated regions. Geometric verification using RANSAC eliminates false matches.
parameters: Octaves: 4, Scales: 5, Descriptor: 128-dim, Matching: ratio test (0.6), Verification: RANSAC
source: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS
useCase: Robust 复制-移动伪造 检测 invariant to scaling, rotation, and 光照 changes

references.title: Amerini, I. et al. (2011) — A SIFT-Based Forensic Method for Copy-Move Attack Detection, IEEE TIFS

strengths:
• 尺度和旋转不变
• 几何验证减少误匹配
• 在计算机视觉中经过验证
• 处理部分遮挡
limitations:
• 计算成本高
• Struggles with smooth/textureless regions
• Memory intensive for many keypoints
• Parameter 灵敏度
